annotations.title: Get your status for a game

description: Get the authenticated user's engagement state for a game: owned, wishlist flags, play count, latest play, fun score, ownership details (trim, purchase price, acquired/removed dates). Read-only. Use after a write tool to verify.

gameId.description: Game UUID. Accepts both the raw UUID and the 'gm_'-prefixed form that get_game_details returns (prefix stripped automatically).
